sections.content: Trust recovery requires hash-bound v3 inputs, persisted run evidence, successor identity controls, bound knowledge selection, validator receipts, and read-only dogfood replay. R0 through R4 define recovery, freshness, legacy reuse, and replay constraints.
sections.title: Requirements

sections.content: The migration bridge materializes fixed RED-test templates for R0, R1, and R2 only. It rejects undeclared slices and conflicting existing content, emits test paths, and produces no authority-bearing output.
sections.title: Migration Bridge

sections.content: terminal_full validates plan state, receipts, knowledge context, bindings, registered commands, and slice tests with fail-closed behavior. validate_all derives deterministic validation identities from plan, slice, registry, contract, and candidate source bytes.
sections.title: Validation Tools
